👥 Asia's most populated countries — 1800 → 2025.

China led Asia every single year for two centuries. In 2021, India passes it 🇮🇳 Watch two moments: the dent of the Great Leap Forward famine in 1961, and the one-child policy from 1979 bending China's curve while India's kept climbing — 326 million to 1,407 for China, 164 million to 1,464 for India.

📊 Data: World Bank (1960–2025) and Gapminder (before 1960), CC BY 4.0. Figures before ~1950 are scholarly reconstructions; India, Pakistan and Bangladesh are counted on today's borders.
